response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), avg_orders AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_order_count FROM order_counts) SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 as region, oc.order_count, (oc.order_count - ao.avg_order_count) as difference FROM order_counts oc JOIN account a ON oc.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id CROSS JOIN avg_orders ao ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
